data.name: AWAKE_KEEP_ON_INTERVAL
data.comment: Keep the system awake for a given time

data.name: AWAKE_OFF
data.value: Off (keep using the selected power plan)
data.comment: Don't keep the system awake, use the selected system power plan

data.name: AWAKE_KEEP_INDEFINITELY
data.comment: Keep the system awake forever

data.name: AWAKE_KEEP_UNTIL_EXPIRATION
data.value: Keep awake until expiration date and time
data.comment: Keep the system awake until expiration date and time

data.name: AWAKE_MINUTE
data.comment: {0} shouldn't be removed. It will be replaced by the number 1 at runtime by the application. Used for defining a period to keep the PC awake.

data.name: AWAKE_MINUTES
data.comment: {0} shouldn't be removed. It will be replaced by a number greater than 1 at runtime by the application. Used for defining a period to keep the PC awake.

data.name: AWAKE_HOUR
data.comment: {0} shouldn't be removed. It will be replaced by the number 1 at runtime by the application. Used for defining a period to keep the PC awake.

data.name: AWAKE_HOURS
data.comment: {0} shouldn't be removed. It will be replaced by a number greater than 1 at runtime by the application. Used for defining a period to keep the PC awake.

data.name: AWAKE_TRAY_DISPLAY
data.comment: Label for the screen/display line in tray tooltip.

data.name: AWAKE_TRAY_UNTIL
data.comment: Label for expiration mode showing end date/time.

data.name: AWAKE_TRAY_REMAINING
data.comment: Suffix for timed mode showing time remaining, e.g. "1:30:00 remaining".

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_DESCRIPTION
data.value: Keep your PC awake on demand. Part of Microsoft PowerToys.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_USAGE
data.comment: Section heading in command-line help.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_COMMANDS
data.comment: Section heading in command-line help.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_OPTIONS
data.comment: Section heading in command-line help.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_EXAMPLES
data.comment: Section heading in command-line help.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ARG_DURATION
data.comment: Placeholder name for a duration argument, shown as <duration>.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ARG_TIME
data.comment: Placeholder name for a time argument, shown as <time>.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_CMD_DEFAULT
data.value: Keep awake until you press Ctrl+C

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_CMD_FOR
data.value: Keep awake for a duration, like 45m or 1h30m
data.comment: Do not translate 45m and 1h30m.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_CMD_UNTIL
data.value: Keep awake until a time, like 17:30 or 2026-12-24T18:00
data.comment: Do not translate the example times.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_OPT_PID
data.value: Stop when the process with this ID exits

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_OPT_PARENT
data.value: Stop when the program that started Awake exits

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_STATUS_TIMED
data.comment: {0} is a duration such as 1h 30m.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_STATUS_UNTIL
data.comment: {0} is a date and time.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_BOUND
data.comment: {0} is a process, such as "process 1234 (cmd.exe)".

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_PROCESS
data.comment: {0} is a process ID number.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_REMAINING
data.comment: {0} is a countdown such as 1:29:58.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_STOPPED
data.value: Awake stopped. Your power plan applies again.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_FINISHED
data.value: Time's up. Your power plan applies again.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_TARGET_EXITED
data.value: The watched process exited. Your power plan applies again.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERROR
data.comment: Prefix for an error message.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_HINT_HELP
data.value: Run {0} --help to see what Awake can do.
data.comment: {0} is the program name. Do not translate --help.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_POLICY
data.value: Awake is turned off by your organization's policy.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_PID_NOT_FOUND
data.value: No running process has the ID {0}.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_PID_SELF
data.value: Awake can't wait for itself to exit.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_PID_ACCESS
data.value: Awake isn't allowed to watch process {0}.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_PARENT_NOT_FOUND
data.value: Couldn't find the program that started Awake.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_DURATION
data.comment: Do not translate 45m, 2h and 1h30m.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_TIME
data.value: "{0}" isn't a time Awake understands. Try 17:30 or 2026-12-24T18:00.
data.comment: Do not translate the example times.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_PID_INVALID
data.value: "{0}" isn't a process ID. Try a number like 1234.
data.comment: {0} is the text typed after --pid.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_SECONDS
data.value: "{0}" isn't a number of seconds. Try 3600 for one hour.
data.comment: {0} is the text typed after --time-limit. Do not translate 3600.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_NEEDS_DURATION
data.comment: {0} is the command as typed, such as "for"; do not translate it. Do not translate 45m and 1h30m.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_NEEDS_TIME
data.comment: {0} is the command or option as typed, such as "until" or "--expire-at"; do not translate it. Do not translate the example times.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_NEEDS_PID
data.comment: {0} is the option as typed, such as "--pid"; do not translate it.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_NEEDS_SECONDS
data.value: {0} needs a number of seconds, like {0} 3600.
data.comment: {0} is the option as typed, such as "--time-limit"; do not translate it. Do not translate 3600.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_POWER
data.value: Windows didn't accept the keep-awake request.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_ERR_START
data.comment: {0} is a technical error description.

data.name: AWAKE_CLI_AUTHOR
data.comment: {0} is the author's name, which is not translated.
